mods.name: Better With Border
mods.description: World border mod for BTA with Dynmap integration

releases.notes:
First stable release of Better With Border for [Better Than Adventure](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/).

## Features

🚧 **World Border Management** — Round and square borders with configurable radius

🌍 **Multi-Dimension Support** — Per-world borders for Overworld, Nether, [Aether ](https://github.com/bta-team-port/better-with-aether) and more

⚡ **Chunk Pre-generation** — Pre-generate all chunks inside the border with `/wb fill`

🗺️ **Dynmap Integration** — Display borders on your web map (requires [better-with-dynmap](https://github.com/SajmonOriginal/better-with-dynmap))

🎮 **Player Management**
- Configurable knockback distance
- Bypass system for specific players
- Whoosh sound effect on border contact

## Requirements

- Better Than Adventure **7.3_04**
- [Babric](https://github.com/Turnip-Labs/bta-fabric-instance-repo) mod loader

## Warning

⚠️ **Backup your world before using `/wb fill`!** Chunk pre-generation modifies world data and cannot be undone.
